home.title: Omadhimbo ga Dementia nAlzheimer nomaliko | Golden Moments
home.description: Omadhimbo gomapikitha gaayakwa ouyuni ngoka ga ka pula, nomaupyakidho gomaliko ya kwatelwa kaantu ya kwatelwa nedementia nAlzheimer nomakwathi gaantu. Kayi na kuyelitha, kayi na omalinga, kayi na omaaludhi.
home.eyebrow: Ka pula · Ka na ontengo · Ka na kuyelitha · Ka na omalinga nomatalo
home.h1: Omadhimbo nomaliko oga yakukwa ookwawo aantu ya kwatelwa nedementia
home.lede: Omadhimbo gapikitha ngoo ya kulondwa, omapikitha ga zi kuyo, noomaliko ngoo tu dhimbe pamwe—nokaape ya kulongola.
home.heroApp: Oshitya application ya ka pula ya iPhone, iPad nAndroid, ine omapikitha goyehala lyoye
home.albumNote: “Omapikitha ngoye ya kofe ya tiyi kakali pamwe.”
home.gamesLede: Omunga nomunga gu li noudhiginini, gwa ya gwa kula, nogwa dhimbekwa nalwaashi. Londa limwe, mu kale pevi nopevi, nomu dhimbeke nokuhenda ngoka oyo.

steps.title: Londa shimwe shi ku dhidhilika
steps.text: Omapikitha gekwathi lyotiyi, omahoto, oompongo nomaato gokuyenda. Ka pumbwa okuyakula okulongo nonghedi kakukwathelwa poshinima.

steps.title: Kaleni pevi nopevi
steps.text: Ka dhimbeke. Nongeyi omapikitha. Ngoye ta ka hokutha omapikitha nkwao ko ngoka nkalipo.

steps.title: Shikala oshinima shokuhoolola naakanya
steps.text: Omadhimbo gumwe ohagu omaliko gashe. “Okatapala sho nagune” ohayi ya monika pomhango.

home.stageLede: Omesho, oomwaaloka dhomukalo, omahoko nomalinga ga yuka monkuyo, dha lukilwa ngoka ka li noudhiginini nale.

stages.title: Oshilongo shotango
stages.text: Dhimbekeni ngaashi kwa shiyanbelwa kanene, nomalonga aanini: omaholelo, omafinda, omadhimbo gomanya nokukonga pamwe.
stages.label: Omaupyakidho gomeho lyotango

stages.title: Oshilongo shomukalo
stages.text: Omaliko ga shiyayo, gomafimbo gaapaukwa mo mayambo: okufuda, okuhapaka, omesho, omadhimbo gomapikitha nomaendo mapuku.
stages.label: Omaupyakidho gomeho lyomukalo

stages.title: Oshilongo shouxuna
stages.text: Okuhokololela nokukwatana nokwiilikwa, nomotjo, nomadhilo, nomakanda: okukwatelwa mayanga, omasimbo ga kendandjiwa, omapikitha nokukala pamwe.
stages.label: Omaupyakidho gomeho lyoukalo

home.specificHtml: Ngele mu li tala shimwe shi shi kwatelwa, longa omaliko nomadhimbo ga Alzheimer, omadhimbo gomalinga ga pumbiwa, omadhina ga shiyapaleka nale omaupyakidho gokuhoolola.
home.approachTitle: Omaliko gomuntu ngoka nomuntu, ihaasho ondjodho yomalinga
home.approachLede: Omadhimbo gaasi ga “omadhimbo gomutwe” gaaholwa nokwiyambeka, omalinga nokukonga okwa lwaashi. Kwa kwatelwa aantu ya kwatelwa nedementia, ngaa ohagu ngaashi onkoyo. Ngoye twa dhimbeka kuuwoko.

principles.title: Kakuna nokukonga
principles.text: Kakuna oshitopa, omalinga, omaukwatho nokupewa. Omapikitha gamwe ga kala ngeyi ohagu oshiyeleko, ihaashi okwa pewa.

principles.title: Omapikitha ohagu ya monika
principles.text: Okutala nokudhidhilika, kohe okukanitha. Okukwatelwa kwomapikitha kukala ko kutanga, kakuna shoka ngoka tu pumbwa okudhiginina.

principles.title: Ouyelele nelalakano
principles.text: Omalongo ga kwatana ga yakula nogaa lidhi. Kohe omapikitha ga kwatelwa koshinima. Kakuna omapikitha ga piyapa nomalongo gaalutwa.

principles.title: Ohwaa lwaashi okuyelela
principles.text: Kakuna oomhango nomadhigo. Omapikitha goye kaa ya kuli pehala lyoye.

guides.title: Ngaashi tu dhimbekela pamwe
guides.text: Okukonakona, okuyakula kokukala, nelelo ngele omadhimbo ga tilike ku dhiginina.

guides.title: Ngele ye ku ganda omaliko
guides.text: Oonkondo dhomalala ga pe ya gandja, nondjila dhokumwe okulonga kotango.

guides.title: Okukonga tablet
guides.text: Omashiwo gamanene, okuhindwa kashona, neshiketha limwe lyehala ndyo ndyeli.

guides.title: Omaliko gaprinta gaakwatha
guides.text: Omafuda gomashiwo manene, omapikitha gokuyuta, bingo nomakaadhi gomalongo.

home.researchTitle: Oohenda yomutwe: oshinima sha monika mo oompango
home.researchText: Dementia inai kalela? Omadhimbo gomutwe ga kwatela? Ngaashi okuyapaleka omaupyakidho, omashithi nomambo gomaulo? Iinyolwa ya kundafana, ngoka ya hala okushikwa eshi ohamu monika mo okuyandjwa.
home.appTitle: Golden Moments pa iPhone, iPad nAndroid
home.appText: Application ya ka pula ohayi shikana kaye yoolingoni, nohayi longele omapikitha goyehala lyoye ngoka u ka londa, ga kalela monkalo yoye. Ondjiyo ye ya taamba: omashiwo gane gaanene, kakuna omalinga, kakuna omatalukilo.

faq.q: Omadhimbo gaanene ga aantu ya kwatelwa nedementia ohagu?
faq.a: Omaudhano omawanawa ogo ngoka ogapu, ge shiwike no kage na omafininiko: omathano omanene gokufaathanitha, okutongola, omapuzili ogapu gomathano, okumanitha omayeletumbulo ge shiwike nawa, okufifa oombala, obingo yomathano nuukarta dhokuhokolola. Ehogololo ewanawa olyo ndyoka omuntu ta nyanyukilwa nena. Yanda oowili dhokuyeleka ethimbo, iitsa naashihe tashi fa ekonakono.

faq.q: Mbela omaudhano ngaka gaamboka ye na uuvu wokudhimbwa ogo goshali?
faq.a: Eeno. Kehe edhano noshinyanyangidhwa ko-Golden Moments oshali, kaape na e-akhaundi, okwiishangitha nenge okukutha ko sha. Omaudhano otaga longo kombrowsa yongodhi, yotablete nenge yokompiyuta.

faq.q: Mbela omaudhano guuluyi ohaga keelele uuvu wokudhimbwa?
faq.a: Kape na edhano lya hololwa kutya ohali keelele uuvu wokudhimbwa, na Golden Moments iha ti ohaku pangelwa nenge ku keelelwe sha. Omaudhano getu ogo gokunyanyukwa nokukala pamwe ethimbo. Oshitopolwa shetu shuukolele wuuluyi otashi yelitha shoka omapekaapeko taga ulike naashoka itaaga ulike.

faq.q: Mbela omaudhano ngaka oge opalele omuntu e na uuvu wa-Alzheimer?
faq.a: Eeno. Uuvu wa-Alzheimer owo unene hawu eta uuvu wokudhimbwa, nomaudhano ngaka oga ningilwa shono: omathano omanene ngoka taga kala ga holoka, omahogololo omahwepo, nokaape na sha shokudhimbulukwa nenge shokupondola pambambo. Okufaathanitha, okutongola nokumanitha omayeletumbulo ge shiwike nawa otashi kongo ontseyo yandhindhilikwa nale pehala lyokwiilonga iinima iipe.

faq.q: Mbela omuntu e li mondondo yahugunina yuuvu wokudhimbwa ota vulu okukutha ombinga miinyangadalwa mbika?
faq.a: Olundji eeno, unene ngele e li pamwe nomuntu komeho ge. Tameka na Konga sha faathana nomathano gaali, Omathano ga taaguluka nuusila wune, epandja lyokufifa oombala nenge okufudha ombepo melulumo. Shi ninga oshipupi, landula nkene e uvite, e to hulitha po ngele a loloka.

faq.q: Mbela uuyelele wandje owu li tuu megameno?
faq.a: Oshitopolwa shika kashi na oma-akhaundi nenge omatseyitho giipindi. Ohatu longitha Google Analytics opo tu uve ko kutya omapandja geni haga talwa. Omathano ngoka to hogololele Omathano ga taaguluka ohaga holoka owala kombrowsa yoye na ihaga tuminwa komalungula nando.

Golden Moments okangundu okashona hoka haka ningi iinyangadalwa yomathano ya ngungumana yayakuluntu yomapata naasilishimpwiyu, kombinga yokomalungula nonge o-api yoshali. Tse katu shi oondohotola, na kape na sha mpaka shi li omayele gopaundjolowele.

playCta.title: Owa pyakudhukwa kudhano lyoombili?
playCta.text: Omathano omanene, kape na owili, kape na iitsa na kape na sha shokwiishangitha. Dhaneni pamwe kombrowsa yoye.

appCta.title: Kutha omaudhano ngaka pamwe nangoye
appCta.text: O-api yoshali yo-Golden Moments ya-iPhone, iPad na-Android: uukwatelo womathano omanene, omaudhano gomathano gefamili lyoye mwene, noongundu dhomathano tadhi longo nopehala lyo-Wi‑Fi. Kape na e-akhaundi, omatseyitho giipindi, owili nenge iitsa.

activities.label: Iinyangadalwa
activities.title: Iinyangadalwa yaamboka ye na uuvu wokudhimbwa
activities.seo: Iinyangadalwa yaamboka ye na uuvu wokudhimbwa: Omadhiladhilo gopondondo
activities.description: Omadhiladhilo giinyangadalwa yaantu mboka ye na uuvu wokudhimbwa pondondo kehe: oomusika, okudhimbulukwa yakale, iilonga yeesiku kehe, omitelelo gopamaiyuvo, iilonga yomiikaha, pondje yegumbo niinyanyangidhwa yoshali.
activities.lede: Oshinyangadalwa shi na oshilonga oshi li kehe shimwe tashi eta ehekeleko, elalakano nenge ompito yokukwatathana. Tameka naashoka omuntu a kala e hole aluhe, e to shi opaleke oonkalo dhanena.

caregiving.label: Esiloshimpwiyu
caregiving.title: Omaviliko gesiloshimpwiyu
caregiving.seo: Omaviliko gesiloshimpwiyu lyuuvu wokudhimbwa: Ekwatho lyolela lyesiku kehe
caregiving.description: Omaviliko gomemeho nohole kaasilishimpwiyu yaamboka ye na uuvu wokudhimbwa: okudhano omaudhano pamwe, okupopithana, omaanyelo, okukala nomalimbililo komatango, ootablete, okuhogolola oo-api nokwiisila oshimpwiyu mwene.
caregiving.lede: Ekwatho lyopuhe na elombwelo lyondondo lyesiku kehe lyokusila oshimpwiyu omuntu e na uuvu wokudhimbwa, mwa kwatelwa okwiisila oshimpwiyu nangoye mwene.

brain-health.label: Uukolele wuuluyi
brain-health.title: Uukolele wuuluyi: Shoka omapekaapeko taga popi
brain-health.seo: Uukolele wuuluyi noshiponga shuuvu wokudhimbwa: Shoka omapekaapeko taga popi
brain-health.description: Mbela uuvu wokudhimbwa otawu vulu tuu okukeelelwa? Omawiliki gashili ge na oonzapo komaupyakadhi guuvu wokudhimbwa, omaudhano guuluyi, okukala wa pila ondjala, iikulya, omadheulo golutu, oomposha, okuuva nomandhindhiliko gopetameko.
brain-health.lede: Shoka omapekaapeko omanene taga ulike shili kombinga yokugwepaleka oshiponga shuuvu wokudhimbwa, sha yelithwa nawa, mwa kwatelwa naampoka uunzapo wu li uunkundi nenge wa mbumbuluka. Uuyelele wowala gwaayehe, hakupangelwa kwakaundjolowele.

guide.sourcesNote: Ohatu kwatakanitha nomahangano nomapekaapeko ngoka epandja ndika lye egamena kugo. Kehe shimwe osha konaakonwa sho epandja lya opalekwa.

healthNotice.title: Uuyelele wowala, hawomayele gopaundjolowele
healthNotice.textHtml: Epandja ndika otali fatulula omapekaapeko ga nyanyangidhwa gomapata. Itali vulu oku ku lombwela shoka shi opalele omuntu gumwe owala. Popya nandohotola manga ino lundulula iikulya, omadheulo golutu, oomposha, omiti nenge iingungumithi yokugwedha ko. Ngele ope ya evundakano lyombadzimo nenge omalunduluko omanyanyami, konga ekwatho lyopaundjolowele meendelelo. Lesha eshiivitho lyetu lyuuyelele wuundjolowele.

about.title: Oshinyangadalwa shokukutha ombinga pamwe, hekonakono lyedhimwalu
about.description: Omolwashike omaudhano go-Golden Moments kaage na oowili, iitsa nenge oondondo, omolwashike omathano haga kala ga holoka, naashoka tatu tula mo naashoka itaatu tula mo kombinga yuuvu wokudhimbwa.
about.lede: Golden Moments oha ningi iinyangadalwa yomathano ya ngungumana yayakuluntu mbyoka omusilishimpwiyu nomuntu e na uuvu wokudhimbwa taya vulu okunyanyukilwa pamwe pehala limwe.
about.bodyHtml:
Ezi tu li tu pandja

Omukumo gwoshiponga ogwa li mo shinene: ehokololo, oshiseko, elilo lokulongisa oshidhigu shiwa, nenge ngeno wa kala pevi nomuntu. Ihagwa okuyeleka omuntu, okumutsa nenge okuholola oshinima shimwe.

Iilonga yo kwaathana omolwondjokonona dhi kala dhi thigwa omukumo gwokukeha, eyelitho, oshiwa nomagumbo. Kuumuntu ya na dementia shi nakukala ngaashi oshitegelo ashi kwa dhimbilwa po nawa. Tu thiyeke shiwa, notu kwatha ndje oohomoka dhoka:

  • Ihamu na sha okukonga. Ihamu oshikwashi, eyelitho, ondjalulo yiinima, oipambwe, oonkalu nenge oonkondo, mesho lyoshilongo shili nashili.
  • Okutala oshiwa po nokuyuka. Oompico ohadhi monika nuuvo ndele. Oompopiliko odhi kandele oompopiliko omuhuka nenge oizemo, ihadhi tha ulike mapukululo nenge oikendelelo.
  • Ya nene, ya yeleka nokuya nawa. Oshinyo nomompico ya nene, okulonga kwomuumbo kwa tsikile, nomalongelo ngoka gali kepaca.
  • Oshinyanyalo shomuntu omunene. Oompico dhokoshilongo shetu nomaupyakidho ga yandjwa ngaashi kaantu yomuumbo. Ihatu kwathele omaupongo, oohumbwa dhokulya nenge iimaliko ye na embo.
  • Eyambo lokuhandula. “Ongaho nombili” ohali monika nawa. Okuhanduka kukahi kwa kala okwa nasha.
  • Ohamu tombele omuntu. Kahamu oonkalo, nenge oompango. Oompico ngoka wa sana ohadhi kala moshigwana shoye.

Ezi kahatu li tu popi

Oonkondo dhetu dhi yandjelwa okuyandja ehokololo nopambelelo. Ihadhi tandjelela, ihadhi yandja oinyanyudho, ihadhi pumbwa, ihadhi kwatha nenge ihadhi tsikila dementia nenge oshiphuka shAlzheimer, nenge ihadhi tala sho muntu a ka ya kohi. Ngeno tu nyola oombuku kohi “oompango yomhango wohomba”, tu popi nawa oshinima shi hashi lenga ohatu popi wa tu popi sha omuhiya, nongeno tu ka monika oonkondo dhetu.

Ose ohe tu

Golden Moments ohayi oshigwana shomuthigo shi nakukala shi li shika. Ihatu li oompepi. Oompango dhetu odhi longekwa kombinda yoomvuliliko dha pandje nondjila, ngaashi National Institute on Aging nAlzheimer’s Association, nomompango dhoshi nayi onagolwa koshikwashi shoompango. Mbela tu nyola nokukonga oompango dhetu ngaho.

Tu udhe shika shi nayi kwathela

Otu hala okuuda shika shi li ya pandu nashika shi ihashi yi pandu, nenge kaantu ya na dementia, aakwashigwa yomuumbo nosho aakwashi yoonkalo. Tuma email kuli {email}.

editorial.title: Ngaho tu nyola nokuhonga oompango dhetu
editorial.description: Ngaho Golden Moments ta hongo, ta nyola, ta yandja iimaliko nokuhandukitha oompango dhayo dhoiponga yo dementia nomhango wohomba, nongaho tu ka yandje shika shi hashi ka tu yandja nando.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Oompango dhetu

Oompango dhetu odhi kwatele pombinda yoomvuliliko dha pandje, ngaashi National Institute on Aging, CDC, Alzheimer’s Association, Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, Family Caregiver Alliance nNHS, nomaupyakidho ga pitithwa koompopiliko dha tulwa, ngaashi Cochrane reviews nomatheko manene oshilongo. Oompango dhimwe nedhimwe odhi li nomaupyakidho ga kwatelwa. Tu tala ko kaadhiyo ndi ngoka tu i kohi, notu popi shika shoka sha popi nenge.

Ngaho tu nyola

  • Nakwiitha oshiwa: shoka sha pumbwa okulongwa nena, nomagano ga pandjwa nawa.
  • Ohatu popi nawa sho oshiwa shi li: tu popi “ohashi kwatelwa”, “ohashi kala”, nenge “oshiwa ohashi ningwa nomatya” ngeno shi li shika.
  • Oshinyanyalo: tu nyola sho aantu ya na dementia ye li aantu yomuumbo, ihatu thigu omaupyakidho nenge oonkalo ngoka tatu komeka.
  • Ihatu popi shika shoka sha tya nenge sha tyeyelela: oshiwa shi tya oyoompango, oonkondo, oompepi, oompopiliko, oupopi wotoni nenge oohaludho.

Ya lalakanitha oompango dhetu

Oompango odhi nyolwa nokulalakanithwa koshigwana shaGolden Moments, nosho nomakwashi gaAI ngoka gaa kwathele mokukonga nokunyola. Oompango odhi lalakanithwa koompopiliko dhadhi nokushigwana kwashigwana. Oompango dhetu ihadhi lalakanithwa koomuuganga nenge oompepi dhopomhango ngoka dhi li koshilongo, notu ihatu popi ngeyi. Oodhi ngoo oopopiliko ya pandje, ihadhi li oupyakidhi wehamaliko lomomhango.

Shika tatu ka yandjelela nando

  • Oohaludho dhoshiponga, omawuhwa, iimaliko, oombelelo nenge oompongo ye ti sho omuntu ta kwatwa nenge ihe kwatwa nenge oshiphuka shAlzheimer.
  • Oompango, oonkondo nenge oontseyo ngoka tadhi popi sho omuntu a li nenge ihe li na dementia.
  • Oompopiliko yo kutameka, okukakula nenge okulongela omaliko gomeya.
  • Oohaludho dhoshiyuma nenge oompango ngoka shi li ngaashi ehokololo nasho ihashi kwatele.

Oohololo nomalinganeko

Oompango dhimwe nedhimwe odhi monika omalongelo gaho dha nyolwa okupita. Ngeno wa mona oshinima shi shiheli nenge omupopiliko gwa kepaka, otu udhe email kuli {email} notu ka kakula tu kakula ngoye.

faq.title: Oinyanyudho nomaupyakidho
faq.seoTitle: Iilonga nomaholelo ya dementia: oinyanyudho nomaupyakidho
faq.description: Oupyakidhi wa pandje ku oinyanyudho dhi li dhi ya pandje ya iilonga nomaholelo ya dementia: iilonga yokulonga, oshiseko shokulonga, iilonga yomatango gehe, omhango wohomba nokukala ngoo kwoshinima.
faq.lede: Oupyakidhi wa pandje nowa kwiikala nawa, okuza kooinyanyudho dhi yandjwa nookwashigwa ya nyanyuka sho pumbwa.

items.q: Iilonga yiipi ya nawa kombinda yomuntu ya na dementia?
items.a: Iilonga ya nawa ohayi kala ya kwahena, ihayi kala ya kooshiwa nohayi kala ihayi yi ka thigu omasiku. Oshinima shi shiwa shi li oshinima ngoka omuntu a hala nena nosho. Okupopika oompico nompico ya monika, okuhandja, oompetekeni dhi kanyeka, okuhumudha oinyanyulo yi shiwa, okumona oompico, nenge okuhumbila mpaka ohayi kwathela aantu aviyali. Ihatu hala oipambwe, oonkalu nenge oshinima shi ka tya ngaashi oompango.

items.q: Iilonga ayi oyi li yi pandjwa mbuluka pandje?
items.a: Eeno. Omaudhano agehe niinyanyangidhwa oyoshali, kapu na ompumbwe yokuninga o-akhaunda, okwiishangitha, okukopolola nenge omatseyitho.

items.q: Omolwashike kaapu na iitsa, oondondo nenge oowili dhokuyeleka ethimbo?
items.a: Endelelo niitsa ohayi shitukitha oshinyangadhalwa oshiwanawa shi ninge ekonakono, shoka tashi vulu okuetitha ohoni nenge egeyo. Otwa tula ombepo menyanyukilweni nokukala pamwe, onkene kapu na shoka tashi dopwa nooto vulu okukankama ethimbo kehe to hala.

items.q: Iikwamashina yini hayi longo nawa noonkondo?
items.a: Ongodhi kehe, o-tablet nenge okompiyuta yi na o-browser yopo-ngashingeyi. O-tablet ya tulwa poshiyambululitho poshitafundja olundji oyo ombwanawa kaantu yaali ya dhane ya kuutumba pombinga nombinga. O-laptop ya mangelwa kotelevisi ohayi longo nawa yoongundu dhaantu.

items.q: Oto tu vulu okudhana noofoto dhetu yene dhuukwanegumbo?
items.a: Eeno. Oofoto dha pashukilathana ohadhi shitukitha oofoto 2 sigo 6 ndhoka wa hogolola dhi ninge omuudhano gwokuunganeka. Oofoto ohadhi kala mo-browser yoye ashike na itadhi londo nenge dhi pungulwe.

items.q: Oshinyangadhalwa nashi kwate ethimbo lithike peni?
items.a: Olundji oominute 10 sigo 20 odha gwana lela, nopamwe noominute 2 odho esindano. Tala komadidiliko gevulwe nenge gegeyo e to kankama manga ku uvitwe nawa. Kapu na ethimbo lya pangelwa ndyoka li li mondjila.

items.q: Ongiini ngele inaya hala okuninga oshinyangadhalwa?
items.a: Simpeka eindo ndyoka, e to kambadhala ishewe konima nenge momukalo gulwe. Eindo otali vulu okuziilila kevulwe, kuuwehame, kokwaahe na elineekelo nenge ashike kokwaana ohokwe. Tala mewiliko lyetu lyaashoka wu na okuninga uuna taya tindi.

items.q: Iinyangadhalwa yini tayi opalele oondondo dhopehulilo dho-dementia?
items.a: Epepeleko nomaiyuvo: okupulakena kumusika ngoka gu holike, okukakunya iikaha no-lotion, okutala oofoto pamwe, okukwata kombangiketayeluka, okukuutumba pondje, nenge omuudhano omupepu gwoofoto pamwe nomuntu e li pombali yawo. Ewiliko lyetu lyopondondo dhopehulilo oli na omadhiladhilo omamvo.

items.q: Opu na tuu iinyangadhalwa yoongundu momagumbo gokulela aakokele?
items.a: Eeno. O-bingo yoothano oyi na uukalata tawu nyanyangidhwa nomuhigi goposhipeleki, na Manitha oshipopilwa nuukalata woombapila dhoonkundathana ohayi longo nawa uuna tayi leshwa pombanda. Ewiliko lyetu lyoomagumbo gaakokele otali popi uuwinji womangundu, omukuutumbilo nomuopalekelo gwaamboka ye na omavulo gi ili nongi ili.

items.q: Omaudhano otaga vulu tuu okukeelela nenge okushonopeka o-dementia?
items.a: Kape na omuudhano gwa monika tagu keelele o-dementia, noomaudhano getu inaga ninga eipopilo lya tya ngawo. Epindiko lyomadhiladhilo pokati kaantu momapekaapeko olya holola uuwanawa uushona maantu mboka ye na o-dementia ya yela sigo opokati, ihe shoka oshi ili kokukeelela omukithi kumuudhano. Tse ohatu gandja omaudhano opo ku kale enyanyukilo nomakwatathano.

Kashi shi shoshili thiluthilu. Omapapekaapeko oga kwatakanitha iinima 14 yuukolele nomukalo gwonkalamwenyo noshiponga sho-dementia, ngaashi ekanitho lyekuuvoko, ombinzi ya londa, okwaainyenga kolutu nokukala kwoye awike. Okukandula po iinima mbika otashi vulika shi shonopeke oshiponga maantu yamwe, ihe aantu oyendji mboka haya ningi kehe shimwe nawa natango ohaye yi mono. Kashi shi epuko lyomuntu nando.

items.q: Okulilika kiikulya omathimbo nomathimbo oshiwanawa tuu kuukolele wouluvi?
items.a: Uunzapo womaantu owu li puushona nowo-petameko, nomapekaapeko ogendji oga ningilwa miinamwenyo. Okulilika kiikulya otaku vulu okukala kushi na egameno kaantu aakokele, unene tuu mboka taya nu omiti dho-sukuka nenge mboka taya kanyatuka inaashi tegelelwa, na inaku gandjwa egano kaantu mboka taya lumbu no-dementia. Popya nendohotola manga ino lundulula omulyo gwoye.

Kape na omau-akhaunda nenge omatseyitho. Ohatu longitha Google Analytics okuyalula aatalelipo nokutala komapandja ngoka haga kwatha, no-browser yoye ohayi dhimbulukwa ngele owa tema komiwiinda omipepu. Oofoto ndhoka to hogolola mOofoto dha pashukilathana kadhi tuminwa nando kointaneta. Tala kombinga yomautho guuyelele wopaumwene omolwuuyelele wa gwedhwa po.
Aaye. Golden Moments oyokwiinyanyudha nuuyelele ashike wowalala. Omapulo guukolele, popya nendohotola, nomolwomeendelelo dhenga ko 112.

faq.moreHtml: Uuyelele owundji: nkene tamu dhana pamwe, uuna taya tindi, iinyangadhalwa yomoondondo dhopehulilo na o-dementia otayi vulu tuu okukeelelwa?

handout.title: Omaudhano gopambili gowala kAantu mboka taya lumbu no-Dementia
handout.seoTitle: Okambapila kokunyanyangidha: Omaudhano gOshali go-Dementia kOintaneta
handout.description: Okambapila kepandja limwe kokunyanyangidha kaakwanegumbo naasilishimpwiyu kombinga yoomaudhano gomathano gomapupu gowala kaantu mboka taya lumbu no-dementia, koongundu dhomaikwatho niikwathitho yelelo.
handout.lede: Nyanyangidha epandja ndi lyongundu yomakwatho, oshikwathitho shelelo nenge komweelo gwokila. Longitha elombwelo lyo-browser yoye lyokunyanyangidha; omalalakano noo-button kadhi monika mepapapila lya nyanyangidhwa.
handout.introHtml: Omathano omanene, oohapu dhopuuyelele na kapu na sha shokundopa. Oshali kongodhi, ko-tablet nenge kokompiyuta, kapu na eishangitho, omatseyitho, oowili dhokuyeleka nenge iitsa. Kuutumbeni pombinga nombinga e tamu pashukilathana.
handout.restHtml:
Uumayele uushona

  • Hogolola ethimbo lyesiku ndyoka omuntu e uvite nawa noonkondo.
  • Tameka nondondo ombwanawa noonkondo. Ootaila ne odha gwana lela.
  • Popi kombinga yoothano. Oonkundathana olundji odho oshiga oshiwanawa.
  • Kankameni manga ku uvitwe nawa. Okuhulitha kuyele oshizemo oshiwanawa.

Opu na wo koshitopolwa shika

  • Iinyanyangidhwa yoshali: omakongo goohapu goondanda oonene, omapandja gokuhola omalwaala, uukalata woombapila dhoonkundathana no-bingo yoothano.
  • Omadhiladhilo giinyangadhalwa kondondo kehe, nomawiliko gokudhana pamwe nogokwiisila oshimpwiyu.

Omolwenyanyukilo nokukala pamwe. Ha mayele guunamiti, ekonakono nenge epango. Golden Moments oya nyanyangidhwa ku-Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) oha pa {count} oombelewa dhomahala dhomalaha ya ningwa koomwenyo dhe dementia, ndjoka oyo ohadhi kala nongeyo dhomalungelo nomafano oga pitikwa, oonkwaala, oondjila dhomaambelela nomaupyakidho gomahala gomaungundu nomafano. Ihaa kala oshitya, oombinga ne oomvula. organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Oomukalo gwoyilongo: Picture bingo ya na oomakadhi goomafano nomutiyi woshiponga, nenge Easy trivia ya na oonkalo 50 nomadhimbo gokuhandukwa noonkalo dhokukwathana.
  • Oonkalo dhomaupyakidho koomakwashi nomakwashi, yokukwatela nomukalo, ngoye yoka ya ningwa mo nomalaadhi. Tangeni 101 oonkalo dhomaupyakidho nenge oomaupyakidho goyilongo koomagumbo gomakwashi.
organizations.restHtml:
Oyilongo otayi kwashika ngiini

  • Oomagumbo gomakwashi nomakwashi gomaungundu: picture bingo nenge okuputhitha omalaadhi komutelevisi yomukutu gwoyilongo, nomuntu omwe ta dhengele oyilongo.
  • Oomagumbo gomaupyakidho gegongalo: oshinya shomitablet nePicture pairs yomatuka ane, koomadhiladhilo gomagongalo gaapwe.
  • Oomaantu ookalo: omasimba gokuwana omashiwana nomakadhi gokukwathana mo koopaketi dhokukwashika ongundu, nosite yi yi mono komitablet dhoomaantu.
  • Oyilongo yokukwashana koomakwashi nomakafe gomaungundu: ekandamwa lyomafano lyeli limwe lya lombwela oomukwashi okuya nalyo kohi.
  • Oomagumbo gomatseyo nooyi yokulongitha oomvula: ekandamwa mo koopaketi dhomakwashi, opo pe na oshinima sha kwashika kohi nenge kocikutu.

Ihatu longo ooshinima ngoye

Oombelewa odhi wa oondjila dhokuhepeka nokukala pamwe. Ihadhi tala, ihadhi tolo, ihadhi kwatha nenge ihadhi longitha dementia, nenge ihadhi kaleka okulonga ngaa, nomwa pondola oyilongo ya ka liyandje nongoye. Ihaa kala oomhala, nomaupyakidho ihaa pumbwa omadhina, oonkalo dhoompito nenge omafano gaampwiyo. Osite oyi oshi shi kwashikwa Google Analytics yokutala oohikomo; eyuvo lyoshiponga olya tala kutya ohaa koleke shike. Omafano gaa kwashikwa mo Photo pairs ohaa kala mokomupeki.

Tuma meso lyetu komulandu gwoyilongo yoye

Ngele oho kala nolulandu lwoyilongo yokukwashika omakwashi, oho li ndi ondjira okulonga kwa {domain}. Oho dhi kopolola ngiyo eyuvo limwe.
organizations.linksHtml:
Oombinga dhi na okuvaathana noonkalo ya: oombelewa dhomahala, omafano gomahala gokukwashika, oonkalo dhAlzheimer's nenge ngiini okuthana pamwe.

Oombuluko nenge oohandiko

Ngele oshinima moshiwana oshi kwatha nenge kashi nyanyukwa, nenge oompumbwa dhomukwashwa kadhi kwatwa kongoye, oonga tulongele kohi po {email}. Oonga tuhe ohamu oompito nenge oohapo dhoyimwe ndjoka ya kaleka.

app.title: Oopaana dhaGolden Moments
app.description: Oopaana dhomahala dhaGolden Moments: okutaandeka omafano nomakwashi kamanene mane, omafano gomalongo gokwahala mo mopaana, oomalaha gomafano ngoye ga kwatela opo ya ka kala kohi, nohaku pumbwa oshiyampinga.
app.lede: Oshinima shoka ushi hoolola mosite, mopaana yi ya kwashikwa mopaana ihayi ya kwatela oomafano gomalongo ngoye.
app.bodyHtml:
Tamekela pokashona

Tameka nuutayela une uunene nomathano ngoka mu shi nawa. Kaleka omathano taga monika, nenge mu ga holeke ngele osho shi li mondjila kune. Omukalo nguka gwombili kagu na oowili tadhi ungaunga, iitsa nenge egeelo lyasha. Hogolola uutayela 4, 6, 8 nenge 12.

Shi ninga sheni yene

Hogolola omathano gezimo to longitha ehogololo lyomathano lyoshikwatekelwa shoye. O-apa ohayi pungula omathano omapepu gokulongithwa miinyangadhalwa yayo. Kayi lesha omathano goye agehe nenge yi lundulule omathano goye yene yotango, nohagu vulu okukaleka sigo omathano 24 mongundu yimwe.

Taleleni kumwe ashike

Taleni ethano limwe ashike lwotango. Omapulo gomahokololo ohaga kongo ompito yokupopya inaashi pula omuntu a dhimbulukwe omadhina nenge a gandje eyamukulo lyondjila. Okutala ashike kumwe okwa gwana.

Otayi longo nopwaana o-intaneta

Omathano gopotameko noongundu adhihe hetatu dhomathano omo dhi li mo-apa. Omathano ngoka we ga eta mo ohaga longo nopwaana o-intaneta. Okuhogolola omathano gotango ngoka ge li ashike mo-iCloud otashi vulika shi pumbwe ekwatathano lyo-intaneta.

Kapu na e-akaundi nenge ompungulilo yokweeta omathano

Omathano gezimo ohaga kala ashike mo-apa koshikwatekelwa shoye. Oto vulu okukutha mo omathano ngaka inoo dhimima po omathano goye geni yotango. Ekuthoko lyomauyelele gokoshikwatekelwa otashi vulika li kwatele mo omauyelele go-apa. Lesha omilandu dhuundjolowele nuukundungu wo-apa, na ekwatho lyo-apa otali ku ulukile ompito kehe.
app.disclaimer: Golden Moments oya nuninwa omainyanyudho noonkundathana dhopokati keni. Kayi konakona, kayi aludha, kayi keelele nenge yi yeleke uupyakadhi wokudhimbwa nenge omukithi gwa-Alzheimer.

gamesIndex.title: Uudhano wOshali ko-Intaneta wAantu ye na Uupyakadhi wokudhimbwa na-Alzheimer
gamesIndex.description: Uudhano woshali ko-intaneta waakokele mboka ye na uupyakadhi wokudhimbwa nenge Alzheimer: okuhanganitha omathano, uupuzili wuupu, okutongola, oomayeletumbulo, okufaalela, nobinko. Kapu na eishangitho, oowili nenge iitsa.
gamesIndex.h1: Uudhano Ombili wAantu ye na Uupyakadhi wokudhimbwa
gamesIndex.lede: Uudhano woshali wu li {count} wokunyandela kumwe moshileshiti shoye sho-intaneta. Omathano omanene, oohapu dha yela, na kapu na shoka tashi ku nyengwa: kape na oowili tadhi dhingoloka, kape na iitsa, kape na eishangitho.
gamesIndex.listName: Uudhano ombili waantu ye na uupyakadhi wokudhimbwa
gamesIndex.byStageLede: Oondondo odho ashike ewiliko lyopotameko. Tala kwaashoka omuntu e hole nosho wo shoka she mu thikama nawa nonena.
gamesIndex.moreHtml: Omaidhiladhilo galwe kokule nekende lyokompiyuta: iinyangadhalwa 101 yaantu ye na uupyakadhi wokudhimbwa, iinyangadhalwa nuudhano waamboka ye na Alzheimer, uudhano ombili wedhimbuluko no-opuzili.

faq.q: Uudhano wuni tu na okutameka nawo?
faq.a: Okuhanganitha omathano guutayela une oyo ehogololo etalala lyotango. Ngele okuhogolola pokati komathano otaku monika ku li oshidhigu unene, kambadhala Konga ngoka ga faathana nomathano gaali. Ngele ongundu yaantu, kambadhala obinko yomathano.

faq.q: Mbela uudhano omo tawu longo mO-iPad nenge moselula?
faq.a: Eeno. Uudhano kehe ohawu longo moshileshiti sho-intaneta mooselula, mootableta nomookompiyuta, nomathano ohaga koko ga udhithe ekende alihe. Otableta ya tulwa poshiteende olundji oyo hayi ningi ompito ombwanawa kaantu yaali.

faq.q: Mbela uudhano mbuka ou wanawa komuntu e na omukithi gwa-Alzheimer?
faq.a: Eeno. Owa ningilwa aantu mboka ye na uupyakadhi wokudhimbwa, mwa kwatelwa Alzheimer, ngoka oye unene e etithi enene. Omathano ohaga kala taga monika, ope na ashike omahoololo omashona, na kapu na oowili nenge iitsa, onkee uudhano owa tala unene kokudhimbulula iinima mbyoka ya tseyika nale pehala lyokudhimbulukwa iipe.

Ou li uudhano wokuhanganitha omathano mboka kehe omukokele ta vulu okuwu nyanyukilwa, ihe inawu ningwa opo wu yelethe edhimbuluko: muudhano wOmafano ga faathana, omathano ohaga kala ga lulilwa pombanda kakele ashike ngele owa hogolola omukalo gulwe. Ewiliko lyetu lyuudhano wedhimbuluko lyaakokele mboka ye na uupyakadhi wokudhimbwa otali yelitha nkene kehe uudhano tawu vulu okukalwa ombili.

faq.q: Mbela ope na uudhano woongundu momagumbo gaakokele?
faq.a: Eeno. Obinko yomathano oyi na uukalata tawu vulu okunyanyangidhwa nomuleshi gwehende lyekende, na Manitha omayeletumbulo pamwe nUukalata wOonkundathana ohawu longo nawa ngele tawu leshelwa ongundu mokule.

faq.a: Eeno. Omathano gopotameko noongundu adhihe hetatu dhomathano omo dhi li mo-apa, nomathano gezimo ohaga longo nopwaana o-intaneta ngele owa ga kopolola mo-apa. Okuhogolola ethano ndyoka li li ashike mo-iCloud otashi vulika shi pumbwe ekwatathano lyo-intaneta.

faq.a: Eeno. Hogolola omathano to longitha ehala lyokuhogolola omathano koshitungithi shoye. O-apa ohayi pungula omatulululo omafupi koshitungithi shoye omolwiinyangadhalwa yayo, kayi ga tula ko-intaneta noihayi lundulula omathano goyene. Oto vulu okukutha mo omatulululo ngaka ethimbo kehe.

faq.q: Mbela oyo o-apa yokudeula uulalombongo nenge yokukonaakona edhimbaluko?
faq.a: Aaye. Golden Moments oya nuninwa enyanyu nokukala pamwe. Kayina oondondo nenge omakonaakono, noihayi dhimbulula, ihayi pange, ihayi keelele nenge yi yeleke edhimbwo lyomadhiladhilo nenge omukithi gwo-Alzheimer.
